# Thrivo

> Thrivo is an honest weight-loss and calorie-tracking app built on transparent
> pricing and real food logging. Made by BeOrchid LLC. Website: https://thrivo.fit

## What Thrivo is

Thrivo is a mobile app (iOS and Android) for weight loss through food logging and
calorie/macro tracking. Its core promise is honesty: transparent pricing, a
genuinely free tier, and frictionless cancellation — no fake coaches, no dark
patterns, no surprise charges.

## Key facts

- Price: Premium is $14.99/month (or $150/year — about two months free).
  There is a free tier that requires no credit card, ever.
- Free trial: Premium offers a 14-day trial. The exact charge date is shown
  upfront before any card is charged.
- Cancellation: 2 taps in-app, with an instant email confirmation.
- Food database: 5 million+ foods across 160+ countries, via Open Food Facts.
- Time to first value: about 60 seconds from opening the app to logging your
  first food. Barcode scanning has no pay wall — it's free on every tier.

## Features

- Barcode food scanner (unlimited, all tiers)
- Manual food search and logging
- Daily calorie totals; full macro tracking (protein, carbs, fat) on Premium
- Personalised calorie target (TDEE) on Premium
- Weight progress charts, streaks, and a projected goal date on Premium
- Water tracking with a daily hydration goal on Premium
- Daily evidence-based tips, clearly labeled as guidance — never medical advice

## Plans

- Free ($0): barcode scanner, manual logging, daily calorie total, 7-day history.
  No credit card.
- Premium ($14.99/month): everything in Free, plus TDEE targets, full macros,
  unlimited history, progress charts, daily nudges, and water tracking.

## What Thrivo is not

- No human coaches and no AI posing as a person — Thrivo never pretends otherwise.
- No hidden charges, no bulk-billing tricks, no surprise renewals.

## Status

Pre-launch as of 2026. Visitors can join the waitlist at https://thrivo.fit to be
notified once at launch.
